reviews.text:
I used the supermarket ‘E-Mart Everyday Gangnam Market Branch’ in the Gangnam area of Korea. During my trip, I needed to make a purchase late at night, but since this place was open until late, I was really saved.

Honestly, I felt that the prices were a little high compared to typical large supermarkets and markets. However, considering the time it takes, it is acceptable and above all, the convenience is great. As souvenirs, I bought a large quantity of the classic "Sunflower Seed Chocolate" and local kimchi.

What particularly impressed me was the clerk's response. It was a fairly slow time, but the lady at the cash register was very friendly. He was worried about me while I was doing a large amount of shopping, so he helped me with the cash register operation, and I felt very warm from his kindness.

I was able to use my credit card for payment without any issues. I think this is the perfect store if you want to go shopping or pick up a souvenir you forgot to buy at night.

reviews.author: David Yoshihara
reviews.text: Overall it was okay, but the price was a bit expensive. It doesn't even seem like I bought a discounted product. I carefully selected and purchased, but it seemed like all the products were priced at full price. I'm not sure if you have to be a member to get a discount. The cashier was very businesslike and didn't seem to care about customers at all. Lastly, I paid with a credit card, but most stores allow customers to choose whether to pay in their local currency or their home currency. However, the cashier processed it so quickly that she didn't even see what currency I had selected. Be careful when purchasing. I probably won't visit again.

reviews.author: GeonyoungLim
reviews.text:
This men's select shop is so impressive that it's surprising that a space like this is hidden in Garosu-gil.

The atmosphere is already overwhelming from the stainless steel bunker-like entrance in front of the building, and as you go down to the basement, you will see a unique interior that looks like a mix between a space station and a football locker room.

Fullcount, Orslow, And Wander, Paraboot, F/ce, Barbour, Ordinary Fits, Gramicci, etc.

There is a really solid lineup of American casual, outdoor, and workwear sensibility brands.

If you like men's clothes, including denim, outerwear, knitwear, shoes, bags, and hats, you will lose track of time looking at them.

In particular, the paraboot (Michael, Chambord, Arles, etc.) lineup and full-count denim display were impressive.
It was good to see and choose F/ce backpacks and And Wander items in person.

Not only clothes, but also bikes, helmets, props, and speakers, the entire store is well decorated as if it were a tasteful space.

Even if “visiting an editing shop” is the goal in itself, it is a place that is satisfying enough.
